table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	invcode     = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
	date        = dbo.saleledger.date, 
	flatdisc    = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc, 
	salestax    = dbo.saleledger.salestax,       
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc, 
	invgstperc1 = dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1,
	doctype = Case dbo.saleledger.salecatcode When 1 Then 'Cash' When 2 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
	dbo.accounts.name, 
	dbo.customer.cp, 
	dbo.customer.address1,
	dbo.customer.address2,
	dbo.customer.city,
	SalesTaxRegNo=dbo.customer.SalesTaxRegNo,
	NIC=dbo.customer.NIC, 
	NTNNO=dbo.customer.NTNNO,
	salereturn = (Select count(*) From SrLedger Where dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.srledger.saleinvcode ),
	amount =  Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.saleprice), 2),    
	itemdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * ( dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01) + (dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc)), 2),    
	invdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100), 2),
	itemsalestax = Sum (Round (dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (dbo.saledetail.looseqty * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - dbo.saledetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.saledetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ) ,
	regno = (Select dbo.patient.regno From dbo.Patient Where dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode ),
	patientname = (Select dbo.patient.name From dbo.Patient Where dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode ),
	designation = (Select dbo.rank.name From dbo.Patient, dbo.Rank Where dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode AND dbo.patient.rankcode = dbo.rank.rankcode),
	department = (Select dbo.unit.name From dbo.Patient, dbo.Unit Where dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode AND dbo.patient.unitcode = dbo.unit.unitcode),
	relation = (Select dbo.relation.name From dbo.relation Where dbo.saleledger.relationcode = dbo.relation.relationcode),
	custrefno = dbo.saleledger.custrefno,
	orderdate = CASE lower(:as_datetype) WHEN 'originaldate' THEN dbo.saleledger.originaldate WHEN 'billingdate' THEN dbo.saleledger.billingdate ELSE dbo.saleledger.date END,
	remarks = dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	InvTotal = dbo.saleledger.invtotal
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saledetail,   
	dbo.accounts, 
	dbo.customer	
WHERE 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode and  
	dbo.saleledger.date Between :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate and
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and
	dbo.saleledger.custcode  = :al_CustCode and 
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and	
	dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.saleledger.custcode 
GROUP BY 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.originaldate,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
	dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
	dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1,
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode, 
	dbo.saleledger.patientcode,
	dbo.saleledger.relationcode,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	 
	dbo.saleledger.billingdate,
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.invtotal,
	dbo.accounts.name,	
	dbo.customer.cp,
	dbo.customer.address1,
	dbo.customer.address2,
	dbo.customer.SalesTaxRegNo,
	dbo.customer.NIC, 
	dbo.customer.NTNNO,
	dbo.customer.city
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	invcode     = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
	date        = dbo.saleledger.date,    
	flatdisc    = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc, 
	salestax    = dbo.saleledger.salestax,       
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc, 
	invgstperc1 = dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1,
	doctype = Case dbo.saleledger.salecatcode When 1 Then 'Cash' When 2 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
	dbo.accounts.name, 
	dbo.customer.cp, 
	dbo.customer.address1,
	dbo.customer.address2,
	dbo.customer.city,
	SalesTaxRegNo=dbo.customer.SalesTaxRegNo,
	NIC=dbo.customer.NIC, 
	NTNNO=dbo.customer.NTNNO,
	salereturn = (Select count(*) From SrLedger Where dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.srledger.saleinvcode ),
	amount =  Round(Sum ( sd.looseqty * sd.saleprice), 2),    
	itemdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum ( sd.looseqty  * ( sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (sd.discperc * .01) + (sd.looseqty  * sd.itemflatdisc)), 2),    
	invdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum ( sd.looseqty   * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (sd.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100), 2),
	itemsalestax = Sum (Round (sd.looseqty * sd.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * sd.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ) ,
	regno = (Select dbo.patient.regno From dbo.Patient Where dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode ),
	patientname = (Select dbo.patient.name From dbo.Patient Where dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode ),
	designation = (Select dbo.rank.name From dbo.Patient, dbo.Rank Where dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode AND dbo.patient.rankcode = dbo.rank.rankcode),
	department = (Select dbo.unit.name From dbo.Patient, dbo.Unit Where dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode AND dbo.patient.unitcode = dbo.unit.unitcode),
	relation = (Select dbo.relation.name From dbo.relation Where dbo.saleledger.relationcode = dbo.relation.relationcode),
	custrefno = dbo.saleledger.custrefno,
	orderdate = CASE lower(:as_datetype) WHEN 'originaldate' THEN dbo.saleledger.originaldate WHEN 'billingdate' THEN dbo.saleledger.billingdate ELSE dbo.saleledger.date END,
	remarks = dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	InvTotal = dbo.saleledger.invtotal
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saleinvdetail sd,
	dbo.accounts, 
	dbo.customer	
WHERE 
	DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N' AND 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode and  
	dbo.saleledger.date Between :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate and
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and
	dbo.saleledger.custcode  = :al_CustCode and 
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and	
	dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.saleledger.custcode 
GROUP BY 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.originaldate,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
	dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
	dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1,
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode, 
	dbo.saleledger.patientcode,
	dbo.saleledger.relationcode,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	 
	dbo.saleledger.billingdate,
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.invtotal,
	dbo.accounts.name,	
	dbo.customer.cp,
	dbo.customer.address1,
	dbo.customer.address2,
	dbo.customer.SalesTaxRegNo,
	dbo.customer.NIC, 
	dbo.customer.NTNNO,
	dbo.customer.city
ORDER BY 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode ASC,   
	dbo.saleledger.date ASC

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: sum(  Round ( (amount  -   itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0)   for all)
